title: thelypteris decurtata subsp. platensis
intro: Thelypteris decurtata subsp. platensis, commonly known as Platyloma platensis, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in South America, for its various health benefits. The Platyloma platensis is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and the treatment of skin conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
